question: How many annual leave days are allowed?
ground_truth: Employees receive 20 paid annual leave days per calendar year.

question: How long is the probation period and can it be extended?
ground_truth: The probation period is 3 months. It can be extended once by up to 3 additional months; it cannot be extended more than once.

question: How many days per week can confirmed employees work remotely?
ground_truth: Confirmed employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with written approval from their line manager. Employees on probation work from the office full-time.

question: Within how many days must an expense claim be submitted, and when are receipts required?
ground_truth: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense being incurred. Receipts are mandatory for every expense above PKR 2,000, or USD 10 for expenses incurred abroad.

question: In which cities does Aurora Dynamics have offices, and which one is the headquarters?
ground_truth: Aurora Dynamics has offices in Lahore, Karachi and Dubai. The Lahore office is the headquarters.

question: On which day of the month is salary paid?
ground_truth: Payroll is processed on the 25th of every month. If the 25th falls on a weekend or public holiday, salary is paid on the preceding working day.

question: What is the annual learning budget and who is eligible for it?
ground_truth: Every confirmed employee has a learning budget of USD 1,000 per year for courses, certifications and conferences. It is not available during probation.

question: How many unused annual leave days can be carried over to the next year, and by when must they be used?
ground_truth: A maximum of 5 unused annual leave days can be carried over into the next calendar year, and they must be used by 31 March.

question: Does the company health insurance cover dental treatment?
ground_truth: No. Dental and optical treatment are not covered. The plan covers inpatient care in full and outpatient care up to PKR 50,000 per year for the employee, spouse and up to 2 children.
